findings.title: Repeated negative retest answers do not accumulate the stated further skip or doubled recheck interval
findings.preconditions: Imported nonoverplayed song: plays2, earlySkips3, lastPlay400 days ago, lastSkip40 days ago; counted-before-first-skip absent/0. probeDue true at each answer.
reproduction: Advance simulated clock31days. Assert probeDue(memory,now) again; retestVerdict(id,false) on second legitimate due retest.
At second verdict+240 days assert skipsWeigh remains true, because second extra skip should extend retestAfter(5) to365-day cap.
findings.expected: Two distinct eligible negative retests accumulate two extra skips; retain history facts separately if desired, but effective retest count/taste must reflect both, and duplicate delivery must not inflate them.
findings.actual: Stored earlySkips still3 and one overwritten verdict=-1; skipsWeigh uses earlySkips+1 forever while verdict staysnegative. Interval remains240 days; assertion expecting suppressed weight atday240 fails.
findings.impact: After repeated deliberate rejections, planner restores normal weight125days earlier than the stated doubled/capped retest semantics. Further negatives beyond the first never increase effective count.
findings.repair_direction: Track durable accumulated effective verdict count with occurrence/idempotence fences, or equivalent explicit state preserving real play/skip provenance; do not rewrite imported history or count repeated delivery as separate answers.
required_regressions: Distinct due negative retests with3 initial skips yield240 then365days; subsequent capped
